name: v1.14.3 - Linked specs, safer globs
body:
## What's New in v1.14.3

This release accepts spec files linked from elsewhere in your project, removes a dependency that kept failing security audits, and fixes a validate hang in pre-commit hooks.

### Improved

- **No more `braces` audit warning** - Installing OpenSpec no longer pulls in the unpatched `braces` package, so `npm audit` in your project stops reporting GHSA-vfj7-8cjw-p6xm through OpenSpec.
- **Glob artifacts stay inside the change** - The propose, ff, continue and explore workflows now choose and check a glob artifact's file path before anything writes it, including a skill or command the schema delegates creation to. A path that would leave the change directory, directly or through a symlink, is refused.

### Fixed

- **Linked spec files** - A capability's `spec.md` can be a symlink to a file elsewhere in the project, such as beside the product docs it belongs to. `list --specs`, `show`, `validate` and `archive` accept it; a link that resolves outside the project is still refused.
- **`validate --all` hanging in hooks** - On a terminal that reports zero columns, as some pre-commit runners provide, the spinner no longer loops forever writing cursor escapes. `OPEN_SPEC_INTERACTIVE=0` and `CI` now turn the spinner off too.
- **Very wide brace patterns** - A `generates` pattern whose braces expand to more than 1,024 paths is rejected with a clear error instead of running `openspec status` out of memory.

## New Contributors

* @CRYPTONIKAV made their first contribution in https://github.com/Fission-AI/OpenSpec/pull/2104
* @surlymochan made their first contribution in https://github.com/Fission-AI/OpenSpec/pull/2103

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Fission-AI/OpenSpec/compare/v1.14.2...v1.14.3
